about: D-96, D-103.8, 0.4.5: a session's short name. Its label, else its title's words (the tool's own name for it, else the first words of its first prompt, as `claude --resume` and Codex's picker list it: one line, about 60 characters cut at a word, never a pasted key or a bare path), else a branch that says what the work was, else its facts: its folder and when it started, never its App or Account. Read by crates/juggler-core (naming.rs tests) and ui/src/lib/session-titles.test.ts; both must agree. `{started}` is each side's own words for when it started ("started 1:14 AM"); `byFacts`: named by its facts.
